message.content: Next: notes CRUD. Each note belongs to whoever created it, and nobody else should be able to see or change it.

content.text: I'll add `src/routes/notes.js` behind `requireUser`. A helper `loadOwnNote` fetches the note and returns 404 when it is missing or belongs to someone else, so other users can't even tell it exists. `GET /notes/:id` and `DELETE /notes/:id` go through it, and `POST /notes` sets `owner_id` from `req.user.id`.

message.content: Nice. Could the list be paged, 20 per page? And for editing, just let me send title and/or body.

content.text: Done: `GET /notes?page=N` returns 20 notes per page, newest first. `PUT /notes/:id` uses `COALESCE` so you can send just the title or just the body; it returns 404 if no row was updated.
There's no test script yet; I checked the routes by hand with curl instead.

message.content: Hmm, I might be misreading this, but when I ask for page=1 I seem to get my 21st to 40th notes, and I never see the newest ones. Would you mind double-checking the offset?

content.text: You're not misreading it, sorry about that. Pages are 1-based but I computed the offset as `page * PAGE_SIZE`, so page 1 skipped the first 20 notes. It should be `(page - 1) * PAGE_SIZE`.
